rules: Two videos a day on the news lane; one documentary per weekend from the bank.
News lane = rolling present-tense update on a live event (the format that wins under the keyword), atempo 1.10, no chapter cards, popfigs only.
Every video names an agency or scientist and shows one spoken verbatim quote on screen.
Close on the unresolved tracking line, then one soft comment + subscribe line.
Packaging copies the proven shape: place or volcano name dominant, number in the title, thumb spell-checked at 300 px.
One heavy job at a time. Renders run in the main chat and the owner is told before launch.
Static gates green before any render; draft before full.
